name: PMI Auth
description: WSL Bash: run PMI's registered release authentication command, reusing existing credentials and the managed Admin session, with attended recovery when required.
content:
(
  set -euo pipefail
  pmi_auth_root="$(python3 -c 'import json, pathlib, sys; pair = json.loads((pathlib.Path.home() / ".local/state/pmi-kc-release/checkout-pair.json").read_text()); print(pair["nativeRoot"]) if pair["schemaVersion"] == 1 and pair["repository"] == "josiahH-cf/pmiKCkb_and_ownerRouter" else sys.exit(1)' 2>/dev/null)" || {
    printf '%s\n' 'NOT READY: the registered PMI WSL release is unavailable; inspect its checkout-pair registration.' >&2
    exit 1
  }
  if [[ "$pmi_auth_root" != /* || ! -r "$pmi_auth_root/scripts/pmi-auth" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'NOT READY: the registered PMI release has no readable scripts/pmi-auth entrypoint.' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  exec bash "$pmi_auth_root/scripts/pmi-auth"
)
